what: MACHAMP unattended loop, WARM-START recipe, generations 8 onward (solver/machamp/loop_sprt.js --recipe warm). Written 2026-09-25 BEFORE generation 8's first self-play game. Every generation runs solver/machamp/preregistration-loop.json unchanged except where stated here.
why: gen6 (H0 after 166 games, 0.434) and gen7 (H0 after 652 games, 0.489) both failed the SPRT against gen5, and both restarted training from MAG v1 + DODUO v1 and PORYGON2 v0, so each candidate threw away what gen5 had learned (docs/_reports/2026-09-25-machamp-loop.md).

changes_from_the_loop.warm_start: MAG/DODUO start from the CURRENT CHAMPION's mag and doduo files; PORYGON2 starts from the champion's pory2 file (was: MAG v1 + DODUO v1, PORYGON2 v0)
changes_from_the_loop.recency_weight: a self-play directory whose manifest league.current digests (mag, doduo, pory2) equal the current champion's files carries sample weight 3; every other directory 1. Weights are normalised to mean 1 over the self-play TRAIN rows, so the self-play:human balance is unchanged (build_doduo.js / build_pory2.js --weights; train_doduo.py / train_pory2.py read w.f32)
changes_from_the_loop.doduo_human_pull: unchanged: beta 0.7, human weight 3.0, anchor = the frozen human clone (DODUO v1). The epoch-selection tolerance (+0.05 nats) is measured from the CLONE's human val NLL, not the warm init's (train_doduo.py --tol-ref anchor), so the drift cannot compound across generations
changes_from_the_loop.pory2_target: unchanged: 0.5 z + 0.5 v_deep, v_deep = 4 rollouts x 3 turns of DODUO-v1 play then frozen PORYGON2 v0 (deep_value.js)
changes_from_the_loop.fallback_decisions: the search's FALLBACK decisions (table too empty to solve, or the search threw; the prior's top legal joint was played) are recorded by solver/mew/play.js in each game's `fallbacks` list from this recipe on, and build_doduo.js keeps them as DODUO targets on the played joint's cell (same beta/anchor mix). Directories played before 2026-09-25 hold none: their fallbacks were never recorded
changes_from_the_loop.no_op: if BOTH nets select epoch -1 (the champion unchanged) the generation cannot be tested against itself and the loop stops

unchanged.selfplay: 1,000 games per generation, seed 200 + n, league { current 0.6, previous 0.2, clone 0.2 }, TRAIN pairs of data/team-pool-frozen-regmc, MILTANK k 4x4, 1 reserved switch row, 1000 ms, depth 0, 3 workers -> solver/out/selfplay/eaa5becc54eb/loop-sp<n>
unchanged.pool: every self-play directory on this release: gen0, gen1, r2-sp0, r2-sp1, r3-sp0, loop-sp6, loop-sp7 and each new loop-sp<k>

gates.G_pory2_human: 95% upper bound of (new - PORYGON2 v0) held-out human log-loss <= +0.004
gates.G_beats_previous: SPRT vs the CURRENT champion: elo0 0, elo1 +20, alpha = beta = 0.05, pair scores, index order, <= 2,000 games, battle seed 9001 + 10 (n - 5), 3 workers; PASS iff H1. Read once, at the bound; no interim LLR is printed
gates.G_not_lose_clone: 200 games vs the human clone (battle seed 9002 + 10 (n - 5)); Wilson 95% upper bound >= 0.5
gates.accept: all three pass; the candidate becomes the champion and the old champion becomes 'previous'

publish: accepted: merge origin/main, write the CHANGELOG-REGMC + RUNNING-NOTES rows (a MINOR above main's top) + one solver/LOG.md line + a section in docs/_reports/2026-09-25-machamp-warm-loop.md, commit models + spec (never data), run solver/tests/test-machamp.js and tests/test-docs-current.js — both GREEN or the loop stops unpushed — then push HEAD:main, never forced. Rejected: the solver/LOG.md line and the report section only.
stop: two consecutive generations that fail the SPRT; or the file solver/out/machamp/STOP; or any error; or a no-op generation
